svg.title: When a comment folds a summary for the maintainers
svg.desc: The AI answers in the reporter's language and also writes a summary for the maintainers in the language of [maintainers] language, English by default. When the answer is in the maintainers' language, the apply job leaves the summary out and says so in the log; so does an empty summary, and the comment on a possible vulnerability never has one. Otherwise the comment ends with the summary, cleaned as every text of the AI, folded under a line from the maintainers' catalog, such as For the maintainers, in English, and its hidden marker records maint=en.
